notes: tapFrac is the real button centre, computed from its RectTransform over the 1242x2688 canvas: fracX = (621 + anchoredX) / 1242, fracY = (1416 - anchoredY) / 2760 (Expand scaling gives a 1242x2760 logical canvas on 1080x2400, and SafeAreaHandler drops content ~36 units). Each step changes the screen: 2 opens the route sheet, 3 switches the chosen route (rim, card face, crest punch and the summary line all move), 4 leaves for the flight, 5 and 6 are two dashes with different outcomes, 7 opens pause and 8 closes it. The last frame lands around second 31 of the run, well inside the 42-second window in which the flight cannot end.
